title: The variation of zeros of the Miller basis
summary: We exhibit a connection between the variation of zeros in the Miller basis of modular forms $q^m+O(q^{\ell+1})$ and a logarithmic version $\mathcal{S}_δ$ of the Szegő curve, where $δ=m/\ell$. When $δ<0.6194$ we show that all the zeros are on the unit arc for $k\gg 0$, while if $δ$ is asymptotically close to 1, we show that all the zeros lie on $\mathcal{S}_δ$.
